## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Provide a clear, high-level summary of changes introduced in this PR.

### Related Issue / Objective
Closes #(issue number) or addresses Phase: (e.g., Phase 0 Foundation / Phase 1 EDA)

---

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Pipeline / DVC / MLflow configuration
- [ ] Documentation update

---

### MLOps & Quality Checklist
- [ ] Code follows PEP 8 standards and project styling rules (`black`, `ruff`).
- [ ] Any modified parameters are documented in `params.yaml` or `configs/config.yaml`.
- [ ] Unit/integration tests added or updated in `tests/`.
- [ ] Test suite passes locally (`make test` or `pytest`).
- [ ] No hardcoded file paths, credentials, API keys, or `.env` files committed.
- [ ] No raw datasets or bulky model binaries committed (DVC used instead).
- [ ] Documentation in `README.md` or `docs/` updated if architectural scope changed.
